initialisation for the K-centers loop, used everywhere EXCEPT Study C1, which varies it deliberately. Changed from kmeans, the package and S0 default, after all three MKCFC variants failed 3 of 3 replicates on arm 6 at d=5, n=500, with "Each cluster must contain at least 10 curves" thrown before the loop even starts. The kmeans option runs fdapace::FPCA on Ly[[1]] ALONE, so it initialises from one variable's non-robust scores; under infinite variance a few extreme subjects form a cluster of their own and the fit is refused. two-staged runs the same kmeans, then falls back to random assignment when min cluster size < 10 or fewer than K clusters appear, which is exactly that failure condition.

Components RETAINED when fitting, as distinct from M_true, which stays at 2. RAISED 2 -> 4 on 2026-09-02. Deliberate OVER-RETENTION relative to the truth: the second stage rotates P x nK_fit stacked scores, so nK_fit = 4 supplies it twelve coordinates where the truth needs six. CHOSEN BY A LABEL-FREE RULE, NOT BY aRI. Cumulative FVE >= 0.90 selects M = 4 on ALL TWELVE scenarios (worst variable, worst branch; fve_summary.csv), while the aRI argmax is 5 or 6 - so the rule is CONSERVATIVE relative to tuning on the truth, which is the whole point. FVE >= 0.95 selects M = 5 where convergence is 0.00 to 0.16, and FVE >= 0.99 is unreachable, so 0.90 is the only threshold giving a usable answer; say so in the paper rather than presenting it as an arbitrary convention. M = 4 IS ALSO THE CONVERGENCE CEILING. MRKCFC-R2 convergence runs 0.95 at M = 3, 0.70 at M = 4, 0.05 at M = 5 and 0.00 at M = 6, with median iter pinned on the maxIter = 100 cap; anything above 4 is an artefact of where the loop was cut off. On A11 it is only 0.16 even at M = 4 - report the rate beside the aRI and note that MKCFC converges 3.5x more often there and lands at chance (0.56, aRI 0.005), so the rate is not the figure of merit.
